title: Load and audit the data
body:
## Goal
Load and audit the data. Work in notebooks/01_data_setup.ipynb.

Owner:@Jalil-g
Depends on:None. Start here.

## Steps
- [ ] Load a private .env with KaggleHub. Download train10000, unlabeled3000, test3000, starter2000, sample3000. Save byte hashes and download time. Do not change raw files.
- [ ] Check exact schemas, nonempty text, unique string IDs, labels0/1, 5000 per class, starter as exact training subset, and sample/test ID agreement. Show lengths and class counts.
